theorems.statement: ∀ (d k : ℕ) (N : Set (Euclid (d + k))) (x : Euclid (d + k)) (ι : Euclid d →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid (d + k)) (ι' : Euclid k →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid (d + k)), IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 2 d N → x ∈ N → (∀ v w, inner ℝ (ι v) (ι' w) = 0) → (∀ y : Euclid (d + k), ∃ v w, y = ι v + ι' w) → tangentSpace N x ⊆ Set.range ι → ∃ (O : Set (Euclid d)) (u : Euclid d → Euclid k) (s : ℝ), IsOpen O ∧ (0 : Euclid d) ∈ O ∧ 0 < s ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ 1 u O ∧ u 0 = 0 ∧ fderiv ℝ u 0 = 0 ∧ (∀ v ∈ O, x + ι v + ι' (u v) ∈ N) ∧ ∀ y ∈ N, dist y x < s → ∃ v ∈ O, y = x + ι v + ι' (u v)
